sections.Profile:
"Baby Pac-Man," released by Bally in October 1982, is a unique hybrid that combines a pinball machine with a video game. Designed by Claude Fernandez with artwork by Margaret Hudson and Pat McMahon, this machine integrates the arcade gameplay of Pac-Man with a pinball playfield. The video game section features a maze without power pellets, requiring players to drop into the pinball section to earn these power-ups.
